verdict.rationale: Aider has no sign-in or account-based free tier, but its documented copy/paste-to-web-chat mode lets a developer use an LLM through a browser chat account without configuring API keys. Running local models via Ollama also avoids API keys, though that involves no personal account. Both are workarounds rather than integrated sign-in. Missing for 10: native personal-account sign-in, a documented free tier, and any integrated (non-copy/paste) keyless access to hosted models.
